title: Riverfront 1046
description:
Stay in a modern riverfront apartment with easy access to Broadway, Nissan Stadium, and Nashville’s best music, food, and nightlife. The space features a king bed, smart TVs, fast WiFi, a full kitchen, and a fireplace for unwinding after a day in the city. Building perks include a seasonal pool, gym, fire pit, grills, laundry, and free parking. Whether you’re here for concerts, exploring downtown, or a weekend escape, this apartment is a stylish and comfortable home base for your Music City trip

Other things to note
Important Information
* Third-floor apartment (stairs required)
* No elevator available
* Contactless self check-in
* Standard check-in begins at 4:00 PM
* Same-day bookings may have adjusted check-in times depending on cleaning schedules.
* Free parking for one vehicle.
* Smart TVs are provided. Guests may log into their own streaming services including Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, and more. Cable service is not provided.
House Rules
Please review before booking:
* Registered guests only. No outside visitors.
* No pets. Unauthorized pets will incur a $500 fee.
* Exterior security cameras may be present for guest safety. There are no cameras inside the apartment.
* We are unable to accommodate local reservations without prior management approval. Unauthorized local bookings may be canceled.
* Reservations made outside Airbnb or HVMB that qualify for a refund are subject to a 3% credit card processing fee.
We look forward to hosting you and helping make your Nashville visit comfortable, memorable, and stress-free!
